$comment: Billing: the console's [orgSlug]/billing sections. Plan and usage show natively; choosing a plan, paying and payment methods open Stripe's hosted Checkout and Customer Portal in the platform's secure in-app browser, as the console opens them in a tab. No purchase happens in the app. Routes: /api/billing/subscription, /api/billing/checkout, /api/billing/invoices, /api/billing/profile, /api/billing/host-usage, /api/billing/usage-budget, /api/billing/storage-overage. Grammar: docs/mobile/native-architecture.md §13.

addons.label: Event Calendar
addons.description: The Event Calendar add-on for your whole workspace, supported directly by Aglyn.

addons.label: Aglyn AI
addons.description: Questions, copy, generated pages, emails, campaigns and products all draw on one pool of AI credits. Your plan includes some; an Aglyn AI tier adds more on top.

addons.label: Site Care
addons.description: We make your site changes for you: hours, prices, photos, a staff member, a seasonal banner, a section on an existing page, up to about an hour of work a month, done within 2 business days. Bigger jobs are quoted first. What it does not cover: plan limits, new pages or forms, redesigns, brand work, photography, ads.
